name: Jruda Quick Share
description: Share the page you are browsing, or selected text, images and links, to your Jruda panel as content.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; media-src blob:; connect-src 'self' https://app.jruda.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
